 Crime Hyderabad Banjara Hills SI arrested for allegedly demanding ₹10 lakh bribe from builder
 Subhransu Satpathy 28 Oct 2026 3:40 PM Share this: HYDERABAD: The Telangana Anti-Corruption Bureau (ACB) has arrested Banjara Hills sub-inspector Vijay for allegedly demanding a ₹10 lakh bribe from the owner of Fortune 99 Homes. The SI allegedly demanded the money to prevent the owner’s arrest in a cheating case.
 The complainant could not pay the alleged bribe, and police arrested him. However, the court rejected the police remand plea and granted him bail. 
 SI allegedly demanded money for protection from arrest
 According to the complaint, the sub-inspector later pressured the complainant to pay money in exchange for protection from arrest in other cases.
 KTR moves High Court over passport notice in Formula E case
 The complainant offered ₹2 lakh and approached the ACB with evidence of the alleged demand.
 ACB investigates possible involvement of other officials
 The ACB registered a case and arrested the sub-inspector after examining the complaint and supporting evidence. 
 The bureau is investigating whether other officials played a role in the alleged bribery attempt.
 The ACB said demanding a bribe constitutes an offence under the Prevention of Corruption Act, even if the accused does not receive the money.
